method.writes: Actual replaceSessions including BEGIN IMMEDIATE/COMMIT; input preparation, checkpoints, digest and EXPLAIN excluded. One reset before each sparse case warms the path. Three or more independent-process pairs in alternating order. Default WAL autocheckpoint and synchronous settings preserved.
method.layout: Daily rollup WITHOUT ROWID physical PK candidates, full daily-table replay transaction measured separately from replaceSessions. Other facts retain stable integer IDs. Existing date/project secondary indexes plus session and model secondaries on candidates. Extra stored month is derived from local_day.
method.reads: Public queryUsagePage with rows+COUNT, limit=100; first read excluded, 3 warm repetitions per process, same final full-changed input for product variants; layout candidates retain initial input, with numeric distributions unchanged by title-only full-changed.
method.memory: Fresh process per pair/variant; RSS/heap after verification and lifetime peak include fixture/result allocations, not an isolated transaction peak. Main DB object bytes from dbstat after checkpoint. No RSS fixed-bound claims.
method.correctness: Independent raw SQL checks were performed for every mutation in the first baseline process of indexExperiments. Final runs use byte-identical normalized input snapshots and compare every fact and full aggregate hash against those expected results. Both final variants were timed again in alternating pairs.
method.excludes: No JSONL parsing, discovery, worker IPC, quota calls or VS Code rendering. Warm OS cache; no cold I/O or 3-second UI freeze claim.

reference.method: Reuses independently validated expected fact/aggregate digests, with byte-identical normalized input snapshots. Both before and final incremental timings were measured again.

method.writes: Actual replaceSessions including BEGIN IMMEDIATE/COMMIT; input preparation, checkpoints, digest and EXPLAIN excluded. One reset before each sparse case warms the path. Three or more independent-process pairs in alternating order. Default WAL autocheckpoint and synchronous settings preserved.
method.layout: Daily rollup WITHOUT ROWID physical PK candidates, full daily-table replay transaction measured separately from replaceSessions. Other facts retain stable integer IDs. Existing date/project secondary indexes plus session and model secondaries on candidates. Extra stored month is derived from local_day.
method.reads: Public queryUsagePage with rows+COUNT, limit=100; first read excluded, 3 warm repetitions per process, same final full-changed input for product variants; layout candidates retain initial input, with numeric distributions unchanged by title-only full-changed.
method.memory: Fresh process per pair/variant; RSS/heap after verification and lifetime peak include fixture/result allocations, not an isolated transaction peak. Main DB object bytes from dbstat after checkpoint. No RSS fixed-bound claims.
method.correctness: Fact hashes normalize only physical row IDs; first baseline process independently checks every sparse/full mutation against raw SQL for both bases and 5 groupings (1e-9 relative float tolerance). All pairs compare before/after fact and complete rollup hashes; noninteger aggregate values use 10 significant digits to ignore floating accumulation order. Layout candidates compare the initial snapshot, product writes compare each resulting mutation. foreign_key_check on each mutation.
method.excludes: No JSONL parsing, discovery, worker IPC, quota calls or VS Code rendering. Warm OS cache; no cold I/O or 3-second UI freeze claim.
